name: Whitespotted sawyer
desc: Whitespotted sawyer (Monochamus scutellatus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Monochamus scutellatus, commonly known as the white-spotted sawyer or spruce sawyer or spruce bug or a hair-eater, is a common wood-boring beetle found throughout North America.
